title: 化学コンピュータ演習
subtitle: Computer Practice for Chemistry
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) use a personal computer for data analysis in chemistry, engineering  (manufacturing).
(2) use spreadsheet software to increase the efficiency of data analysis.
(3) learn how to solve problems in chemistry and engineering and enhance your understanding of chemistry and engineering.
(4) learn the basics of programming utilizing artificial intelligence.
advice:
The course will cover:
1. Document preparation, including chemical formulas and crystal structures.
2. Basic knowledge about spreadsheet software, including plotting and visualization of numerical data.
3. Numerical simulations in physical chemistry and chemical engineering.
4. Numerical technique and utilities for finding solutions.
5. Programming in BASIC computer language.

Students are expected to bring their personal computer to every class.
Be sure that the computer works well before the beginning of the semester.
Students are expected to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class.
requiredKnowledge: Install the specified application (freeware, database access) on your PC before class begins.

activityGoals.body: Prepare a document with chemical structural formulas
Analyze experimental data using a spreadsheet
Explain the basic concepts of programming and data manipulation

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Can prepare well-formed documents with chemical structural formulas.
(2) Can correctly perform chemistry and engineering calculations with a PC.
(3) Can prepare a useful program in BASIC.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Can prepare documents with chemical structural formulas.
(2) Can perform simple calculations in chemistry and engineering using a PC.
(3) Can prepare a small program in BASIC.
